info.title: Learnspace API
info.description: Versioned Learnspace backend API. Runtime payloads are validated with shared Zod schemas.

post.description: Creates an organization membership and, when necessary, its global user identity. Existing global users are linked without changing their identity fields.

patch.description: Updates organization-local membership role, status, and scopes. Email, display name, avatar URL, and user status are global identity fields and cannot be changed when the user belongs to another organization.
